question: What is the meaning of raw material percentage in relation to efficiency of recycling process?
description: The raw material percentage in relation to the efficiency of the recycling process indicates the proportion of non-virgin and rapidly renewable materials used in the construction of a unit. This percentage plays a crucial role in determining the circularity and sustainability of the unit, as it influences the potential for materials to be prepared for return into pure-type material cycles at the end of their life.
